WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) as actor_count
  FROM film f
  LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) as avg_actors FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.film_id, s1.actor_count, s1.actor_count - s2.avg_actors as diff
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s1.actor_count > s2.avg_actors
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) as avg_above_avg FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT s3.film_id, s3.actor_count, s3.diff, s3.actor_count - s4.avg_above_avg as diff2
  FROM step3 s3
  CROSS JOIN step4 s4
  WHERE s3.actor_count > s4.avg_above_avg
)
SELECT 
  SUM(actor_count) as sum_actors,
  AVG(diff) as avg_diff,
  AVG(diff2) as avg_diff2
FROM step5
